newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian jobless may hit 9.0 pct - Access.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian jobless may hit 9.0 pct - Access.

text.p: Consultancy firm Access Economics said on Wednesday it expected the Australian unemployment rate to rise to nearly nine percent in mid-1997.
The government, in its August 20 budget, forecast the unemployment rate to remain steady at an average of 8.5 percent over the 1996/97 year.

"We agree business investment will be strong due to communications and resource investment, but expect excess stocks to be run down and subtract from growth, unlike the treasury," Access said in its October report.
"As a result, we are much more pessimistic about the unemployment rate, which we expect to rise to nearly nine percent in mid-1997, while other forecasters see a decline."
Access said it expected economic growth to remain slow over the remainder of calendar 1996.
"This is consistent with current employment and job ads data and the profit squeeze on industrial firms," it said.
However, it said investment in the resources sector would help to boost overall business investment.
"Resource investment will be strong enough to keep business investment growing, despite a slowdown in non-resource manufacturing investment," Access said.
The government has forecast total business investment to average 14 percent over fiscal 1996/97 ending June 30, compared with an average of 9.7 percent in the previous year.
